description: LAYER 4: Backend Admin Endpoint Stubs - Add admin analytics, security, and management stub endpoints that return proper empty structures
steps: 1. In apps/backend/app/api/v1/admin_analytics.py: Add stub routes for all missing analytics endpoints. Each returns a valid default response. Add: GET /analytics/daily (returns {daily: [], days: 30}), GET /analytics/revenue (returns {revenue: [], total: 0}), GET /analytics/predictor (returns {predictions: [], accuracy: 0}), GET /analytics/cf-status (returns {configured: false, auth_ok: false}), POST /analytics/cf-recheck (returns {status: 'ok', auth_ok: false}), GET /analytics/cf-overview (returns {requests: 0, bandwidth: 0, threats: 0}), GET /analytics/bot-traffic (returns {bots: [], total: 0}), GET /analytics/hydrate-stats (returns {stats: []}), GET /analytics/review-prompt-stats (returns {stats: [], funnel: {}}), GET /analytics/review-prompt-stats/baseline-noise (returns {baselines: []}), GET /analytics/review-prompt-stats/by-reason-trend (returns {trend: []}), GET /analytics/content-card-views (returns {views: [], total: 0}), GET /analytics/page-conversions (returns {conversions: []}). All must call _validate_admin_session(request).

2. Create apps/backend/app/api/v1/admin_security.py: Add a router with stub endpoints. Use _validate_admin_session pattern from admin_analytics.py. Add: GET /security/spoofed-bots (returns {bots: [], total: 0}), GET /security/blocked-ips (returns {ips: [], total: 0}), GET /security/block-trends (returns {trends: []}), POST /security/block-ip (returns {status: 'ok'}), POST /security/unblock-ip (returns {status: 'ok'}), GET /security/ttl-monitor (returns {monitors: []}), GET /security/collection-size-history (returns {history: []}).

3. In apps/backend/app/api/v1/admin_settings.py: Add stub routes for all missing admin management endpoints: GET /diagnostics (returns {status: 'healthy', checks: {}}), POST /break-glass/disable (returns {status: 'ok'}), GET/POST /roadmap (GET returns {items: []}, POST returns {status: 'ok', id: 'new'}), DELETE/PUT /roadmap/{id} (returns {status: 'ok'}), GET/PUT /plan-config (GET returns {plans: []}, PUT returns {status: 'ok'}), GET/PUT /api-config (GET returns {config: {}}, PUT returns {status: 'ok'}), GET /activity-log (returns {logs: []}), POST /cache/purge-all (returns {status: 'ok', purged: 0}). All use _validate_admin_session and _csrf_check on mutating routes.

4. In apps/backend/app/main.py: Import and register admin_security router: from app.api.v1 import admin_security. Add: app.include_router(admin_security.router, prefix='/api/v1/admin', tags=['Admin Security']).
acceptance_criteria: All admin analytics sub-endpoints return valid JSON with proper structure
admin_security.py exists with all 7 security endpoints
admin_settings.py has all management endpoints (diagnostics, roadmap, plan-config, api-config, activity-log, cache/purge-all, break-glass/disable)
admin_security router is registered in main.py
All files parse without Python syntax errors
